duration: 6-week season starting the week of January 18, 2027
name: Davis Junior Basketball Coach, Official and Score Keeper
org: City of Davis Parks and Community Services
what_you_do: You referee or keep score at youth basketball games on Saturdays, or coach a team of 3rd to 6th graders. Hours are 5 to 10 a week for officials and 3 to 8 for coaches.
who_can_apply: Age 15 or older to officiate or keep score, and 16 or older to coach. You need CPR and First Aid certification before the season starts and a working knowledge of basketball rules.
deadline_text: The posting is open continuously. Mandatory training is the week of January 4, 2027 and a coaching clinic on January 9, 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the City of Davis job page (NEOGOV). Applicants are screened on experience and may be interviewed.
notes: Temporary part-time with no benefits. Games are Saturdays at the Davis High School community gyms. Other City of Davis seasonal postings such as Parks Maintenance Aide (18 and older) and Pool Maintenance Aide (21 and older) are not open to teens.
